Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that P. J. O'Rourke was born first (1947) compared to José Echegaray y Eizaguirre (1832). This is a fundamental logical error in comparing dates; 1832 is chronologically before 1947. While the WebSurfer failed to successfully load the Britannica main page for P. J. O'Rourke due to a timeout and a "Page Not Found" error, the Planner failed to recognize that the available data (Echegaray born in 1832, O'Rourke born in 1947) clearly indicated Echegaray was born first. Instead of correcting the error or acknowledging the impossibility of O'Rourke being born first, the Planner made a definitive and factually wrong statement in the final decision step, reversing the correct chronological order.
